Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect can only be activated against 1 of your opponent's Digimon. You can't use a single copy of this card to reduce the DP of multiple Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 or more cards in hand when I use this effect, can I give 2 or more different Digimon -1000 DP?

Effect: [Main] Trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP for each card in your hand for the turn.
